summary: Backend-only regression + new-feature verification for EscalaFácil. Verified new CyclePattern 'SD_SN_F_F_F' is accepted and echoed by POST /api/workplaces; the new optional field `cycle_repeat_months` round-trips correctly (None when omitted, echoed on create with value 2, updatable to 6 via PUT, and correctly returned by GET /api/workplaces for both workplaces). Bogus cycle_pattern 'XYZ' rejected with 422. Regression: all 5 previously supported patterns (SD_F_SN_F_F, SD_SN_F_F, SD_F_F_SN_F_F, SD_F_F_SD_F_F, SD_F_SN_F) still 201; shift-override upserts across all 7 shift types (SD, SN, MANHA, TARDE, AVULSO, FOLGA, FERIAS) plus delete, holidays CRUD, events CRUD, and account soft-deletion (with e-mail reuse) all pass. 23/23 tests green against the public preview URL.
action_items: No product bugs. Optional: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'|'shutdown') in server.py is deprecated — migrate to lifespan handlers when convenient (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:37-44 CyclePattern Literal correctly extended with 'SD_SN_F_F_F'; Pydantic validation returns 422 for unknown values on both POST and PUT.
server.py:80,100,122 cycle_repeat_months added as Optional[int] on WorkplaceCreate/Update/Workplace with default None — round-trips to Mongo verified via GET.
server.py:236-244 wp_defaults backfills cycle_repeat_months=None for legacy docs, keeping GET stable for pre-existing rows.

server.py:337-347 PUT update_workplace skips None values before $set — matches spec 'None means always', so clients must send null-clearing via a different mechanism if ever needed (current requirement doesn't need this).

Note: cycle_repeat_months is typed Optional[int] without a Literal[1,2,6] constraint, so any int (e.g. 3, -1) would be accepted server-side. If the domain truly only supports 1/2/6/null, consider constraining to Literal[1,2,6] or adding a validator. Not tested as a bug since the review request didn't specify server-side rejection of other ints.
seed_data_creation: Reused demo@escalafacil.com/demo123456 via register-then-login fallback. All test workplaces prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up in a module-scoped autouse teardown. Account-deletion test uses a fresh unique email each run and self-cleans.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_cycle_repeat_months.py -v -n 0 (NOT -p no:xdist; pytest.ini's addopts already injects -n/--dist so use -n 0 for serial). Public URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Existing companion suite: test_cycle_patterns.py still valid. cycle_repeat_months accepted values per spec: null, 1, 2, 6 — but server currently does NOT constrain int values, so extra values would slip through.
